[[GEINST.DOC]] – installation guide

[[GEREADME.DOC]] – list of files and changelog

[[GESYSOP.DOC]] – list of [[Sys|SYS]] commands available to the sysop (included in source package)

[[GETERM.DOC]] – how to use the [[Data|DATA]] command (included in source package)

[[MBMGEHLP.MSG]] – in-game [[Help|HELP]] messages in text editable format (converted to .MCV for runtime)

[[MBMGEMAL.DAT]] – mailbox database

[[MBMGEMNU.TXT]] – the text displayed when a user selects "What's new?" from the main menu

MBMGEMP.DLL – the game executable

[[MBMGEMP.DOC]] – user's guide

MBMGEMP.MDF – module definition file

[[MBMGEMSG.MSG]] – main configuration file in text editable format (converted to .MCV for runtime)

[[MBMGEPLT.DAT]] – planet database

MBMGEPLT.NEW – empty planet database

[[MBMGESHP.DAT]] – ship database

[[MBMGESHP.MSG]] – ship configuration file in text editable format (converted to .MCV for runtime)

MBMGESHP.NEW – empty ship database

[[MBMGETEA.DAT]] – team database

MBMGETEA.NEW – empty team database

[[MBMGEUSR.DAT]] – user database

MBMGEUSR.NEW – empty user database
